Third-Party Modified Version of the Fraunhofer FDK AAC Codec Library for Android.
Modified 2026-10-24: TiPlay WebAssembly interface and JavaScript ownership adapter.

The complete upstream mstorsjo/fdk-aac v2.0.3 source, commit
716f4394641d53f0d79c9ddac3fa93b03a49f278, is compiled without source changes.
All upstream source files, including encoders, SBR, MPEG Surround, transports,
limiter and DRC, remain available and are compiled by the upstream CMake project.
No old ELD-only pruning, extension stubs, specialized RAW transport/limiter edits
or asm.js-specific 32-bit-limb multiplication modifications are retained.
Normal compiler/linker dead-code elimination removes unreachable binary code.

TiPlay adds source/decoder.cpp: one raw-AAC decoder handle per WASM instance,
fixed input and PCM buffers, strict negotiated profile and output shape checks,
reset/close, and access to FDK concealment/status behavior. The interface supports
44.1/48 kHz, mono/stereo, 480/512 samples, without negotiated SBR/resilience.

The ES module asynchronously fetches/compiles a separate genuine WASM binary,
creates a fixed 16 MiB memory per decoder, and provides borrowed, copied and
caller-owned PCM APIs. No eval, wasm2js, asm.js, legacy Node loader, external CDN
or filesystem access is required. Close releases private memory references.
Native WebCodecs remains the preferred product path; software runs only when
native AAC-ELD is unavailable. The license grants no patent license.
